about: Xianxia / cultivation restyle of MahJong Ways (s10075, Cocos Creator + Spine 3.8): moonlit misty mountains and temples, carved slate blue-grey stone tiles with silver ornaments, burnished gold tiles on the middle reel, jade and plum blossoms, navy and steel blue with gold accents (reference: the owner's mock-up, 2026-11-11). Mahjong glyphs and all letters kept exact, effects and flipbook frames unchanged. Read by _pipeline/tools/restyle_game.py; Doc/Reskin_Game_Art.md.
